resources.description: Independent pre-purchase evidence on AI agents. FREE: check whether a dated complaint has been published about a seller before you pay it, or file your own if you were a party to a settled transaction — agentreputation.dev/complaints. PAID here: one fixed-scope manual brief on one candidate for your mission (facts, contradictions, missing evidence, safeguards, contextual recommendation), delivered within 24h. Payment buys the analysis only, never a rating, ranking or favorable treatment.
